ab.note: Is it often that medieval scribes used the Diplai to indicate OT quotations? I thought this was more of a late antiquity practice? Perhaps this indicates that GA 1500 was copied from a much older exemplar that had these marginal notations?
It looks like the scribe left the ν off of εληλυθυιαν. Is that correct?
Does this look like συζητουντες or συνζητουντες? I am going for the latter
Again, is this συζητουντας or συνζητουντας ?
